# Expenses guide

How staff claim back money they spent for work. No code reads this file.

1. Keep the receipt. A photo is fine.
2. Fill in the expenses form with the date, the amount and what it was for. For mileage, see step 7.
3. Attach the receipt and send the form to your manager.
4. Your manager approves it and finance pays it with your next salary.

Mileage is paid at the standard rate.
